lyrics:
[00:02.040]
[00:03.000]Nothing more than strangers
[00:04.800]Passing by out on the street
[00:11.390]Memories are fading though
[00:13.370]It's only been a week
[00:17.900]All the little things are gone
[00:19.890]The things we used to be
[00:25.230]Nobody could take us down
[00:27.570]There was only you and me
[00:32.700]And without you I can't be
[00:36.240]You're the universe to me
[00:40.070]You're the air in my lungs
[00:41.760]You're the fields where I run
[00:43.610]You're the sky where I'm floating
[00:47.890]It's you, you, you
[00:58.150]It's you, woah
[01:02.590]And without you I can't be
[01:06.080]You're the universe to me
[01:09.760]You're the air in my lungs
[01:11.350]You're the fields where I run
[01:13.440]You're the sky where I'm floating
[01:47.160]It's you, you, you
[01:58.170]It's you, woah
[02:30.590]Don't want to be a stranger
[02:32.200]Want to be the one you need
[02:38.650]I can be your world, your life
[02:40.390]Your lover, all for free
[02:45.680]All the little things come back
[02:47.620]The things we used to be
[02:52.740]Nobody can take us down there
